notes:
Contact: VP Product (Tara Lind). Mid-market product analytics company — multi-tenant SaaS with tiered customers (free, pro, enterprise). Primary workloads: in-app conversational assistant for troubleshooting (chat) + semantic doc search (embeddings) + light reranking.

Hosted API trial summary (2 weeks):
- Traffic observed: steady-state ~4 QPS, morning peak windows up to 18 QPS for 10-15 minutes; weekend troughs ~1 QPS.
- Concurrency: observed 4-8 concurrent streams typically; spikes to ~14 during internal demo cadence.
- Token mix: median request 320 prompt tokens / 140 completion tokens for chat; heavy support docs when invoked produce up to 2,400 prompt tokens occasionally. Embeddings account for ~35% of request count but only ~12% of token volume.
- Latency: avg 280ms tail P95 ~620ms on Hosted API (region us-east). Desired P95 target for Dedicated is <=250ms.
- Cost sensitivity: high at scale; looking to reduce per-token cost by 30-50% vs Hosted retail pricing via Dedicated reserved commits and quantized model variants.
- Model preferences: open-model preference (LlamaX-like family) for cost and license; fallback to stronger proprietary model for enterprise-tier customers.

- "We need consistent latency for enterprise SLAs — can't have variance during morning peaks." — Tara Lind
- "If Dedicated gives us 40% lower unit cost at 95% utilization, we can justify a 12–18 month reserved commit." — Head of Finance (email 2026-02-26)
